clips.title: The story
paras: Austil de Mon is a Forsaken warrior trainer stationed in Brill within Tirisfal Glades. Based out of the Gallows' End Tavern, he instructs newly risen warriors looking to hone their martial prowess in service of the Dark Lady.

Found inside the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, Austil de Mon serves as one of the earliest instructors for Forsaken warriors venturing out of Deathknell. While the living once populated the inn to drink and rest, Austil now uses the gloomy refuge to teach newly liberated undead how to channel raw martial discipline and ruthless combat techniques against the kingdom's surrounding foes.
